titulo_es: Send a package and ask for the cost

texto: Identify which data the form requests and in which order; also review the amount, time and supporting.

bloques.pregunta: Listen to the instructions and recognize the data to be completed or checked.
bloques.audio: Πόσο κοστίζει να στείλω αυτό το δέμα στην Κρήτη; Η απόδειξη δείχνει ότι η πληρωμή έγινε χθες το απόγευμα. Στο έντυπο διαμονής γράψτε τη διεύθυνση και τις ημερομηνίες.

opciones.texto: How much does it cost to send this package to Crete?
opciones.explicacion: Identify the information expressed in the audio.

opciones.texto: The receipt indicates that the payment was made yesterday afternoon.
opciones.explicacion: The audio does not present that data.

opciones.texto: I left a message on the answering machine: I'll be there at seven, at the station entrance.
opciones.explicacion: This option adds or changes information.
